caption: Basiliek, Meerssen
composition: Marl Gothic basilica with a small roof turret, no west tower · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The basilica at Meerssen is a Gothic cross church of Limburg marl, with flying buttresses. The west tower was lost and was not rebuilt. The present accent is the small roof turret from the 1936-1938 works, and the west end is the three-bay extension of those years. It is clear, about 13.7°C, with wind near 10.1 km/h and cloud cover about 9%. The church is closed. No shop name is readable.
